description: We are the team behind INTERSTELLAR REAPERS, an interactive space exploration project designed to make learning about space and spacecraft missions more interesting and engaging. Our main challenge was to create a space mission simulation in which users must design a spacecraft while considering real mission constraints such as budget, mass, power, and science data.
summary: Interstellar Reapers is a browser-based space mission game built in a single HTML file with Three.js. You start in the Mission Designer, choosing the rocket, power, antenna, and instruments across six stages while balancing mass, power, and budget. Then you pilot your rocket in 3D from Earth to the Moon, Mars, the asteroid belt, or Jupiter. You steer with the mouse, use cruise drive and brakes, avoid debris, and slow down to enter orbit. Your hull condition and piloting speed affect the science data you send home and your final score. A separate Asteroid Fact File mission lets you fly through an asteroid field collecting 10 facts, each with NASA images and source links.
details:
Interstellar Reapers is a browser-based space game where players design a spacecraft, launch it across the Solar System, and explore a 3D asteroid belt. Players choose a destination, rocket, power system, antenna, and science instruments while managing mass, power, budget, and science data. They then fly through space, collect 10 NASA-powered Fact Files, protect their shield, and earn a science score.

The project makes space science fun and easy to understand. It teaches players about solar power, antennas, spacecraft design, asteroids, and the importance of returning scientific data to Earth. Its goal is to inspire interest in space exploration and STEM learning through interactive gameplay.

It was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript and runs in a web browser on a normal computer or laptop. The project is creative because it combines mission planning, 3D exploration, NASA imagery, and educational facts in one game. The team focused on making it engaging, easy to control, visually immersive, and educational.
